# Where Gē works now: the myths behind the markets
If the stories are true in the way that matters, they should show up in the world without being invoked. **Gē** shows up constantly.

Gē is a primordial power whose myths are acts of generation and revenge. She creates without a mate, then conspires with her son Kronos against her husband Ouranos.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Gē
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** Earth
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Technology & Innovation
- **Strongest seat:** Environmental & Climate Services
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 87 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**Birth of the Cosmos.** After Chaos came Gē 'broad-breasted,' the ever-sure seat of all immortals.  She gave birth to Ouranos, the mountains, and Pontos, the sea. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**The Castration of Ouranos.** Gē grew weary of Ouranos forcing her children back into her womb.  She fashioned the adamantine sickle and persuaded Kronos to ambush his father. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Environmental & Climate Services

*Climate science, ecology, and sustainability consulting. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The same Earth in her shortest name.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Agriculture, Food & Harvest

*Farming, grain, food production, and agtech. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The same earth under a shorter name.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Mapping & Geospatial

*Maps, GIS, and location intelligence. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Geography, geology, and geometry all open with her name.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Mining & Natural Resources

*Extraction, minerals, and subterranean wealth. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*Every vein and lode is cut from her body; the black stone was her oldest cult-image.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Gē performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Gē is a primordial power whose myths are acts of generation and revenge. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in environmental & climate services, agriculture, food & harvest, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/ge/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
